title: Rubio de Francia Extrapolation Theorem for Quasi non-increasing Sequences
summary: We prove the discrete Rubio de Francia extrapolation theorem for a pair of quasi non-increasing sequences with $\mathcal{QB}_{β, p}$ weight class. Also, a weight characterization of the boundedness of the generalized discrete Hardy averagin19g operator on the class of quasi non-increasing sequences from $l_w^p(\mathbb{Z}^+)$ is proved.
